description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of IM bots
kebab_example: aliyun agentrun list-im-bots --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --bot-name example-string --agent-runtime-id example-string --bot-biz-type example-string --status example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIMBots

parameters.description_en: The page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.
parameters.help_en: The page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1–100. Default: 20.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1–100. Default: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The name of the IM bot. The system performs a case-insensitive substring search.
parameters.help_en: The name of the IM bot. The system performs a case-insensitive substring search
parameters.name: bot_name

parameters.description_en: The ID of the agent runtime.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent runtime
parameters.name: agent_runtime_id

parameters.description_en: The business type of the bot.
parameters.help_en: The business type of the bot
parameters.name: bot_biz_type
